queriesNow: 1 booking.findUnique per booking in the page that has fromReschedule set
queriesAfter: 1 booking.findMany with `uid: { in: [...] }` before the map, then a lookup in memory
why: `plainBookings.map(async (booking) => ...)` issues prisma.booking.findUnique({ where: { uid: booking.fromReschedule } }) per row to read a single `rescheduledBy` column; Promise.all makes the calls concurrent but does not reduce their number, and this is the main bookings list handler.

queriesNow: 1 destinationCalendar.findUnique plus 1 delete per event type, and a separate eventType.update per event type
queriesAfter: delete directly by the id already in hand; batch the location updates
why: The findUnique re-fetches a row the loop already holds — the branch condition just read eventType.destinationCalendar?.credential?.appId — so it is a wholly redundant round trip per event type, followed by a delete that only needs that id.
The cron writes a reminderMail row per booking inside `for (const booking of bookingsToRemind...)`; the rows are independent and could be accumulated and inserted once.
